verdict.rationale: Justworks has its own Xero accounting integration that maps each pay type to Chart of Accounts lines, with department, office and employee overrides, and syncs payroll invoices manually or automatically. That covers getting payroll entries into the ledger, and a Custom Payroll Report exists under Analytics. However, there is no evidence of an API or file export an agent could pull journal data from, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404. Missing for 10: documented payroll/journal data API, explicit export format (CSV/journal export), agent-accessible programmatic access, ledger support beyond Xero, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payroll journal data via API or export and reconcile the entries into my ledger

citations.quote: you'll need to map each pay type in Justworks to an account or sub-account from your Chart of Accounts in Xero.
Sync method: Manually sync invoices or Allow them to automatically sync the day after processing.
you'll have the option to override the same line items by department to their own accounts in Xero.
You can check this information in Analytics > Custom Payroll Report
